High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is second application filed u/S 439 of Cr.P.C./483 of BNSS seeking regular bail by the applicant/accused relating to FIR/Crime No.905/2013 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Rajendra Nagar, District Indore (M.P.) for the offence punishable u/S 420, 506, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC.
2.
It is a case of bail jump.

3. His first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 06.09.2024 passed in MCRC No.34588/2024 with liberty to renew his prayer after completion of three months in custody from the date of said order.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that as per order of the Trial Court, on 27.09.2019,
permanent arrest warrant was issued against the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:9673 2 MCRC-12852-2025 applicant and in compliance thereof, applicant was arrested on 27.03.2024 and is in custody since then and has completed more than one year in jail.

Counsel for the applicant assures that the applicant will not abscond further and also will regularly appear before the Trial Court and comply with all the conditions imposed by this Court hence, prays that this application for bail be allowed and he be released on bail.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the State has objected the prayer by submitting that it is a case of bail jump and after 13 years of absconsion, applicant was arrested and due to his absconsion, the trial was delayed hence, some stringent conditions be imposed upon the applicant while allowing the bail application.
6.

Having considered the rival submissions and looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case so also custody period of the applicant, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I allow the bail application and it is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One lac only) with two separate sureties of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court with a direction that he will cooperate in trial and present himself regularly before the Trial Court on each and every date fixed by the Court concerned during trial.

7. By way of abundant caution, it is further directed that the applicant shall also mark his presence before the concerned Police Station on first Monday of every month between 10.00 AM to 12.00 Noon during pendency of the trial.

Any default in attendance in Court and marking presence in the concerned police station, would result in cancellation of bail granted by this Court thereby entitling NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:9673 3 MCRC-12852-2025 the police to take the applicant in custody immediately.
8. With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stands disposed of.
9. A copy of this order be sent to the Court concerned for its compliance.
